reviews.comment: The entire class is so unnecessarily demanding with an insane amount of hws and quizzes constantly. The exams are take home and online but stupidly hard and essentially zero partial credit. Dr. Kim isn't very helpful either so you're basically just on your own to figure out problems.

That other person who rated is delusional.  Every question you get wrong on the exam was 20% partial credit. It did not matter HOW much work you had you always got 20% partial. This class has the POOREST system of grading exams. Getting almost 0 points off a 9 point question was awful and you SHOULD NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Good prof just a little quiet during lectures and I ended up not going for the last bit of the semester,there's lots of hw but most of it comes from the book. He gives take home exams but they're definitely not easy and add a level of difficulty from the HW and example problems. Overall it's a good class and I would advise to pay attention in class
